Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [You originally sent me the wrong color…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a41939fc6a25a6f38b6dcd9)
You originally sent me the wrong color of pillow and said you were sorry and would send the correct one. However it was 2 1/2 months later. I saved the incorrect one to use the box you were to be sending me the correct color in. I had no idea how long it would take. Once I received the correct pillow, I put the incorrect color pillow in the box and asked why the return label was not working. Your reply was that I should have returned it within 30 days. Ummm...the wrong color was your mistake, as was sending the correct color 2 1/2 months later. I'm not sure that adds up.

June 23, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jun 30, 2026

Hi Sue,

Thank you for your feedback! We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience regarding the incorrect item. We see that our Customer support team provided a return label for the item, and we’re here to assist you with any follow-up needed. Please reply to the original email thread with the agent who assisted you, and we'll ensure you're taken care of.

Lulu and Georgia
